decisions.reason: A dedicated page signals the firm treats this upholstery fabric as a core collection item, and upholstery lines typically stay in the range for several years.

The bouclé-effect decorative fabric is only mentioned on the website and follows a fashion trend, so it is at moderate risk, but one year is usually too short for a textile collection to rotate it out.
Flame-retardant curtain fabrics serve steady contract and hospitality demand, and the dedicated page indicates strategic importance.
The double-face wool-blend fabric gets limited website presence and has higher material costs, but it likely remains in the current collection cycle.
The wool bouclé leno is a niche, trend-driven item with little visibility, which raises its drop risk, though it will probably stay until the next collection revision.
